Team 17 technical artifact: a website that turns the post-training survey export into checked findings and a dashboard. No install, no login, no commands.

TO VIEW THE RESULTS
1. Open https://team17-everymind.vercel.app in any web browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari; desktop or phone).
2. The dashboard for the provided dataset opens directly. Every number shows how many people it is based on and a confidence range. Groups with fewer than 10 people are hidden.

TO RE-RUN IT ON THE PROVIDED DATASET (or next month's export)
1. Click "Update with a new survey export" at the top of the page.
2. Drag BuildFest_EveryMind_Survey_Data_FULL.xlsx onto the page, or click "Choose a file…".
3. Wait for "Done". The first update takes about a minute while the browser loads its tools; later updates take seconds. Everything is calculated inside the browser tab: the file is not uploaded anywhere.
4. The dashboard rebuilds from the file. Counties or answer labels it doesn't recognize are listed under "How to read this, and its limits" → "Data checks", never dropped.
5. Optional: click "Download this dashboard" to save it as a single file you can email.

SOURCE CODE (optional, for reviewers)
1. Click "Source code (.zip)" at the top right of the website, and unzip it.
2. With Python 3.10 or newer, in the unzipped Team17_TechnicalArtifact folder, copy the dataset into data/raw/ and run:
   python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
   make run DATA=data/raw/BuildFest_EveryMind_Survey_Data_FULL.xlsx
README.md inside the zip has the full steps, including Windows.
